xrefdescription.para: BENCHMARK(VoiceSession, CreateSession) Measure: session creation time Assert: < 100ms GATE_SESSION_CREATE <= 100ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceSession, CreateSessionConcurrent10) Measure: time for 10 concurrent creates Assert: < 500ms total
BENCHMARK(VoiceSession, DeleteSession) Measure: session cleanup time Assert: < 50ms GATE_SESSION_DELETE <= 50ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceSession, ScalingTo100Sessions) Measure: peak memory with 100 concurrent sessions Assert: < 500MB GATE_SESSION_MEMORY_100 <= 500MB
BENCHMARK(VoiceSession, ScalingTo1000Sessions) Measure: peak memory with 1000 concurrent sessions Assert: < 2GB GATE_SESSION_MEMORY_1000 <= 2GB
BENCHMARK(VoiceSession, ResourceCleanupNoLeak) Measure: peak - baseline after 1000 create/delete cycles Assert: leak < 10MB GATE_SESSION_CLEANUP_LEAK <= 10MB

briefdescription.para: Google Benchmark suite for Voice session lifecycle operations.

Benchmarks:
GATE_SESSION_CREATE <= 100ms
